summary: Reject Proxy internal-method operations after revocation while preserving operations such as typeof that do not invoke a Proxy internal method.

target.notes: Use the JavaScript object-model runtime. Proxy semantics require trap lookup, handler calls, target internal methods, revocation checks, and invariant enforcement.

semantics.validation: Proxy internal methods call ValidateNonRevokedProxy and throw TypeError when [[ProxyTarget]] is null
semantics.typeof: typeof does not invoke these internal methods and remains non-throwing
semantics.identity: revocation does not replace the proxy reference

caveats: Do not model Proxy as a plain C# decorator or Dictionary wrapper; observable internal-method interception and invariants must be preserved.

tests.name: typeof revoked proxy still works
tests.expected_behavior: prints object for an object-target proxy
